owner_decisions.detail: Approved the 16-feature queue derived from docs/ROADMAP.md. F001 is recorded as pre-completed; F002-F016 are pending. Active milestone M1. No constitution bootstrap.
AUTO_CHECKPOINT marker (scripts/loop.sh --auto-checkpoint): F002 checkpoint auto-approved. All outer validation commands passed.
AUTO_CHECKPOINT marker: F003 checkpoint auto-approved. tsc, npm test, db:verify, lint, build all passed.

features.title: Engineering Foundation
acceptance: ESLint, formatting, typecheck command, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, GitHub Actions, and environment validation are implemented.
At least one Playwright smoke test exists.

features.title: Database Foundation
acceptance: Supabase, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL migrations are configured.
The required tables tenants, tenant_domains, profiles, tenant_members, showroom_settings, vehicles, and vehicle_images exist.
Development seeds include Prima Auto Gallery and Tenant B Test Showroom.
Existing mock vehicle data exists in the database.
Schema migration works from an empty database.

features.title: Authentication
acceptance: Login, logout, password reset, authenticated admin routes, and session handling are implemented.
An authenticated owner can access admin.

features.title: Multi-Tenant Security
acceptance: Tenant memberships, tenant context, hostname resolver, tenant-scoped queries, RLS, permission helpers, and tenant isolation tests are implemented.
Tenant B data cannot appear for Tenant A.
Service role never reaches the browser.
Do not proceed if tenant isolation tests fail.

features.title: Connect Public Website to Database
features.roadmap_section: # 48. PHASE 6 — Connect Public Website to Database
acceptance: Homepage featured units, inventory, vehicle detail, related vehicles, and showroom data are database-driven.
No public vehicle data comes from hard-coded mock arrays.

features.title: Admin Vehicle CRUD
acceptance: Create, edit, publish, reserve, sell, archive, duplicate, and delete are implemented.
Zod schemas are shared where reasonable between server and client.
Admin creates vehicle, the vehicle is stored, admin publishes, and the vehicle is visible publicly.
No manual DB operations are required.

features.title: Image Management
acceptance: Cloudinary upload, multiple upload, progress, reordering, cover selection, deletion, validation, and optimization are implemented.
Approximately 15 high-resolution images are tested in one vehicle workflow.
Deleting a vehicle handles the media policy correctly.

features.title: Showroom Settings
acceptance: Name, tagline, description, logo, hero image, colors, contact details, address, social links, opening hours, and SEO fields are editable.
Admin updates showroom and the public website reflects the configuration.

features.title: Lead Capture
acceptance: The lead table, contact form, WhatsApp tracking, lead dashboard, and lead status updates are implemented.
No advanced CRM features are created.
Customer inquiry becomes a tenant lead and appears in the admin dashboard.

features.title: SEO Productionization
acceptance: Dynamic metadata, OpenGraph, canonical, sitemap, robots, structured data, and sold listing handling are implemented.
Generated HTML is verified, not just browser-rendered metadata.

features.title: Platform Administration
acceptance: Create tenant, disable tenant, assign owner, inspect tenant, set subdomain, and set plan/status are available.
The interface is not exposed to normal showroom owners.

features.title: Subdomain Routing
acceptance: Two hostnames display different showroom branding, inventory, and contact details from one deployment.

features.title: Custom Domains
acceptance: Domain registration, verification state, DNS instructions, domain routing, and SSL provisioning integration are implemented.
The platform subdomain remains available as a fallback.
Custom domains are implemented only after wildcard subdomains are stable.

features.title: Analytics
acceptance: vehicle_view, inventory_search, filter_use, whatsapp_click, contact_submit, and vehicle_share are tracked.
Dashboard metrics for vehicle views, most viewed vehicles, WhatsApp clicks, new leads, and conversion percentage are available.
Analytics does not block MVP launch.

features.title: Production Hardening
acceptance: Security, RLS, authorization, dependency, mobile, desktop, SEO, accessibility, performance, and failure-state audits are performed.
The system is tested with two or more realistic showrooms.
